text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
AmericanCity(y) ::: y is an American city.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Novel(y) ::: y is a novel.
WrittenBy(y, x) ::: y is written by x.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Year(y, z) ::: y was written in year z.
FamilyHistory(y) ::: y is Family History.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BG ::: background predicate for "if" statements.
FamilySecrets(x) ::: x is Family Secrets.
Boston(y) ::: y is Boston.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.

Premises:
[BG] If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x (BornIn(x, y) ∧ AmericanCity(y) → American(x))
[BG] If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
∀y ∀x ((Novel(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x)) → NovelWriter(x))
DaniShapiro is an American writer.
Author(DaniShapiro, FamilyHistory)
FamilyHistory is a novel written in 2003.
Novel(FamilyHistory) ∧ Year(FamilyHistory, 2003)
FamilyHistory is written by Dani Shapiro.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilyHistory)
Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets)
FamilySecrets is a podcast.
DaniShapiro is an American.
American(DaniShapiro)
Boston is an American city.
AmericanCity(Boston)

Conclusion:
∃x (BornIn(DaniShapiro, x) ∧ Boston(x))
